note: Synthetic rehearsal thresholds, not calibrated. They are not forecasting accuracy, official warning criteria or a validated model; a trigger candidate is information for a human, never a warning.

heavy_rain.label: Flood / heavy rain
heavy_rain.rationale: Daily rainfall total. 64.5 mm matches the lower bound of the IMD 'heavy rain' category (64.5-115.5 mm); 35 mm is an earlier rehearsal watch level.

river_discharge.label: River discharge
river_discharge.rationale: GloFAS model discharge relative to the median of the returned series for the same cell; model output, not gauge data.

fire.label: Active fire
fire.rationale: Count of high-confidence VIIRS detections within 10 km of a grid point; detections are satellite hotspots, not confirmed fires.

landslide.label: Landslide
landslide.rationale: LHASA model nowcast probability; model output with known false alarms.

wind.label: Wind gusts
wind.rationale: Daily maximum 10 m gust from the forecast model.

heat.label: Heat
heat.rationale: Daily maximum 2 m temperature; 45 degC is near the IMD heat-wave absolute criterion for plains.
